panels.title: Serving model
panels.description: The model currently answering /predict. Changes automatically when the orchestrator reroutes.

panels.title: Detected drift
panels.description: What the orchestrator's fingerprint says about the latest window of 1,000 transactions.

panels.title: Injected drift (truth)
panels.description: Ground truth from the stream producer. The system never reads this; it is shown only to compare.

panels.title: Orchestrator
panels.description: Warm-up: the first 5,000 transactions become the clean reference before monitoring begins.

panels.title: Live F2 score
panels.description: F2 over the last 45 s of labeled predictions. F2 weights recall higher than precision, which is what fraud teams care about. Red < 0.3, amber < 0.5, green >= 0.5.

targets.expr: 5*(sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="tp"}[45s])) or vector(0)) / (5*(sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="tp"}[45s])) or vector(0)) + 4*(sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="fn"}[45s])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="fp"}[45s])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Predictions per second served by the API.

panels.title: 1 · Drift signal per feature group
panels.description: Each line is how far a feature group has moved from recent normal traffic, in units of its noise floor. A = transaction amount, B = device/email/product, C = velocity. Crossing the dashed line means that group is drifting.

panels.title: 2 · Breadth: features drifting at once
panels.description: A broad shift touches dozens of features at once. Crossing the dashed line classifies the drift as universal (U) instead of a single specialist type.

panels.title: 3 · Which model is serving
panels.description: The active route over time. Every change here was made by the orchestrator, not a person.

panels.title: 4 · Injected vs. detected drift
panels.description: Top lane: what was injected. Bottom lane: what the system detected. The gap is detection delay.

panels.title: 5 · Live F2 score
panels.description: F2 over a 45 s window. The white line is the overall score; colored lines are per model. Watch it dip when drift starts and recover after the switch.

targets.expr: 5*(sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="tp"}[45s])) or vector(0)) / (5*(sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="tp"}[45s])) or vector(0)) + 4*(sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="fn"}[45s])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="fp"}[45s])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: 6 · Precision and recall
panels.description: Precision: share of flagged transactions that are fraud. Recall: share of fraud that gets caught.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="tp"}[45s])) or vector(0)) / ((sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="tp"}[45s])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="fp"}[45s])) or vector(0)))

(sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="tp"}[45s])) or vector(0)) / ((sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="tp"}[45s])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(fraud_labeled_outcomes_total{outcome="fn"}[45s])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: 7 · Traffic share by model
panels.description: Requests per second answered by each model.

panels.title: 8 · Inference latency (p95)
panels.description: 95th-percentile time to score one transaction inside the API.

panels.title: Route switches
panels.description: Automatic model switches in the selected time range.

panels.title: Orchestrator API errors
panels.description: Failed routing calls from the orchestrator to the API. Should stay at 0.

panels.title: 9 · Fraud flag rate
panels.description: Share of transactions the serving model flags as fraud. It rises during a drift because the injected fraud raises the true fraud rate.

panels.title: 10 · Predictions by class
panels.description: Requests per second predicted legitimate (class 0) versus fraud (class 1).

panels.title: 11 · Prediction confidence distribution
panels.description: How sure the serving model is about each transaction, from 0 (legitimate) to 1 (fraud). Brighter cells mean more transactions at that confidence.

panels.title: 12 · Guardrail: live F2 of the serving model
panels.description: F2 of the serving model over its last 200 labeled transactions, counted only from the moment it was routed in. Shown once there is enough evidence (150 rows, 10 frauds). If a specialist or the universal model stays below the dashed floor for two checks while drift is active, the orchestrator rolls it back automatically.

panels.title: Guardrail status
panels.description: Live F2 of the serving model since it was routed in, against the 0.5 floor. Collecting evidence means too few labeled rows so far.

panels.title: Guardrail rollbacks
panels.description: Times the guardrail rolled a failing model back automatically in the selected time range.
